LESSON: SOURCE DOCUMENTS AND BOOKS OF ORIGINAL ENTRY

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: BUSINESS STUDIES
Strand: Financial Records in Business
Topic 4.3: Source Documents and Books of Original Entry
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 18

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Source Documents and Books of Original Entry, part of Financial Records in Business in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 BUSINESS STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: Why are the books of original entry important in bookkeeping?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. explain the importance of source documents and books of original entry in bookkeeping,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Source Documents and Books of Original Entry in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. analyse the source documents used for recording business transactions,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Source Documents and Books of Original Entry in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. examine the books of original entry used in bookkeeping,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Source Documents and Books of Original Entry in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. record transactions in the relevant books of original entry, ● learners are guided to discuss and present on the meaning and importance of source documents and books of original entry in bookkeeping, ● in pairs, learners are guided to search and present using available resources the information on types of source documents for recording business transactions, ● in groups, learners are guided to brainstorm and present on the types of books of original entry, Why are the books of original entry important in bookkeeping? 47

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Source Documents and Books of Original Entry in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

E. appreciate the books of original entry for recording business transactions. ● learners are guided to record business transactions in relevant books of original entry.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Source Documents and Books of Original Entry in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. explain the importance of source documents and books of original entry in bookkeeping,

   Source Documents and Books of Original Entry helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. analyse the source documents used for recording business transactions,

   Source Documents and Books of Original Entry helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. examine the books of original entry used in bookkeeping,

   Source Documents and Books of Original Entry helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. record transactions in the relevant books of original entry, ● learners are guided to discuss and present on the meaning and importance of source documents and books of original entry in bookkeeping, ● in pairs, learners are guided to search and present using available resources the information on types of source documents for recording business transactions, ● in groups, learners are guided to brainstorm and present on the types of books of original entry, Why are the books of original entry important in bookkeeping? 47

   Source Documents and Books of Original Entry helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

E. appreciate the books of original entry for recording business transactions. ● learners are guided to record business transactions in relevant books of original entry.

   Source Documents and Books of Original Entry helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Source Documents and Books of Original Entry together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: learner develops effective communication skills when discussing and presenting on the meaning and

importance of source documents and books of original entry in book-keeping.

● Critical thinking and problem solving: learner develops evaluation and decision making skills when recording

business transactions in relevant books of original entry.

Values:
● Love: learner respects others when discussing and presenting on the meaning and importance of source documents

and books of original entry in book-keeping.

● Respect: learner shows regard for the contributions of every member of the team when discussing and presenting

on the meaning and importance of source documents and books of original entry in book-keeping.

● Responsibility: learner shows determination when recording business transactions in relevant books of original

entry.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Financial Literacy: learner enhances book-keeping skills when recording business transactions in relevant books

of original entry.

● Peer Education and Mentorship: learner enhances interpersonal relationships when discussing and presenting on

the meaning and importance of source documents and books of original entry in book-keeping.

● Internet Safety and Security: Learner enhances responsible online behaviour when using digital devices with

assistive technology to search for information on the types of source documents for recording business

transactions.

48

● Analysing methods used in making payments for goods and services.

● Preparing a statement of financial position after adjustments to determine the net worth of a business.

● Examining the books of original entry used in bookkeeping.

● Recording transactions in the relevant books of original entry.
